remarks: Unique & beautifully renovated and move-in ready, this Wildflower unit delivers the perfect blend of modern luxury, outdoor adventure, and village convenience. Experience the best of four-season living with the flexibility to enjoy weekends yourself or generate rental income. Wake up to scenic views of the slopes of Holiday Valley from your private deck, then stroll to the lifts or tee time for an early round of golf.  Located in one of Western New York’s most desirable resort communities, this property extends the perfect blend of recreation with four season enjoyment and year-round activities at Holiday Valley. The bright, open-concept main level seamlessly connects the kitchen and living area, creating an inviting space for relaxing or entertaining. The fireplace is beautiful and extends warmth with views. Step outside onto the open deck to enjoy fresh mountain air and slope views. The lower level features 1 bedroom and a newly renovated full bath, while the loft-level bedroom provides additional sleeping space for family and guests. Meticulously maintained and used only for personal enjoyment, 1 Bedroom with loft area makes this a 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath home.  Fully furnished (personal items excluded), this property presents a rare opportunity to enjoy both lifestyle and rental flexibility in one of Ellicottville’s most sought-after resort communities. Don’t miss your opportunity to own a piece of Ellicottville’s four-season lifestyle.
